notes.title: Escape - Above the Clouds!
notes.content: We are happy to announce the second installment of the Escape!VR series! This time, you'll have to escape a penthouse - above the clouds! The new game is about three times as long and challenging as "The Basement". Check out our new game [url=store.steampowered.com/app/566970/EscapeVR_Above_the_Clouds]here[/url] (10% discount if you own The Basement!)

notes.title: Oculus Touch support + new languages!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

we've just released version 1.1 of EscapeVR! -The Basement-! 

This version includes support for the Oculus Rift and Touch controllers. You need to have the Rift set up for 360° use, as is described in the [url=https://support.oculus.com/help/oculus/199906947113632/]Oculus knowledge base[/url]. If you run into any issues, let us know.

We've also added full support for German and Russian, the latter by Ilja Zegars and Igor Golyanov - you should check out their YouTube channel [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCz_eg9j1dpCZ0aE-DVnT23Q]Тёрки и Телеги[/url]!

The update also includes a couple of minor changes to improve gameplay.

[b]We are looking for translators![/b] If your native language is Chinese, Spanish, or French, and you're interested in helping us out, send us an email at contact@sourcenity.com .

Thanks, and have fun playing!

Philip
